title: Evidence Gate Before Entry
topic: Why a missing data check should stop an order
disclosure: Paper-trading education only; not live-money performance; not investment advice; no guaranteed returns.

scenes.title: Start with evidence
scenes.narration: A disciplined process starts before the order. First, confirm the evidence chain.

scenes.title: Use completed bars
scenes.narration: Use completed, timestamped bars. An unfinished candle can change the setup.

scenes.title: Check the quote
scenes.narration: Then verify that the quote is fresh and the spread is acceptable for the intended route.

scenes.title: Confirm context
scenes.narration: For an intraday entry, confirm the price context, including VWAP and the required completed candle sequence.

scenes.title: Missing evidence means hold
scenes.narration: If a required check is missing or ambiguous, the correct action is to hold or take no trade.

scenes.title: Process over pressure
scenes.narration: Good process does not promise returns. It protects decisions from unsupported assumptions.
